findings.summary: Activating either skip link moves focus to the authentication main element, which has no visible focus indicator.
findings.fix: Add a clear, high-contrast focus style for `.auth-shell:focus` or `.auth-shell:focus-visible` in auth.css so the skip-link destination is visibly indicated.
findings.evidence: Both pages use `<main class="auth-shell" id="main-content" tabindex="-1">`; existing main focus styles target `.main-content`, not `.auth-shell`.

passed: Login and setup skip links are first in the page and become visible on focus; their target is a main element with tabindex="-1".
Login and setup controls use native, labeled inputs, buttons, and links with a sequential DOM order.
Visible focus styles are defined for links, buttons, and form inputs; no positive tabindex values were found.
notes: The shared dashboard layout was absent during review; dashboard sign-out markup could not be inspected.
